description.value: The Country Store is a grocery store, Return-It bottle depot, and freight forwarding location serving Lillooet, BC, operating seven days a week. It is a rare multi-function stop in a small interior community along cycling routes through the Lillooet area. Touring cyclists will find it a practical resupply point with grocery shopping and beverage container returns under one roof.
